quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after alcohol affect your blood alcohol level?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It stops the alcohol from working.
It does not change your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It does not change your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot change how much alcohol is in your blood or make you sober.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: An intersection.
A road curve.
A right turn.
A lane change.

questions.correctAnswerText: An intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
Pedestrians cannot cross here.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drivers should slow down and be ready to stop for pedestrians.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Where should your car be after you complete the turn?

options.text: In the right lane.
In the center of the street.
In the left lane.
In the lane with the least traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the left lane.
questions.explanation: When turning left onto a one-way street, finish your turn in the left lane. This is closest to the lane you just left.

questions.question: You are in a line of traffic crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates. What should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You can pass slower drivers while crossing the tracks.
Make sure you have enough space to cross all the tracks without stopping.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure you have enough space to cross all the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before driving onto the tracks, check that you have enough room to cross completely without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right and then left.
The road ahead curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and you can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on slippery roads?

options.text: Drive at the speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Drive closer to the car in front of you.
Avoid sudden speed or direction changes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden speed or direction changes.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: Your car does not have ABS. How should you brake in an emergency stop?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.
Pump the brakes firmly.
Tap the brakes lightly.
Release the brake pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pump the brakes firmly.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes helps your car stop quickly while keeping steering control.

questions.question: When does your car need a longer distance to stop?

options.text: On wet or icy roads.
On paved highways.
When driving at night.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: On wet or icy roads.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance increases on wet or icy roads. It also increases on loose gravel or stone surfaces.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, it shows 30 mph.

questions.question: Highway signs that warn about dangerous conditions are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. Always follow warning signs. Ignoring them could cause an accident.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels pointed straight.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels toward the side of the road when parking downhill. This keeps your car from rolling into traffic if it starts to move.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a curb, how should you position your front wheels?

options.text: Turn them sharply toward the curb.
Turn them slightly to the right.
Turn them sharply away from the curb.
Keep them straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply away from the curb when parking uphill. This stops your car from rolling into traffic. If there is no curb, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead.
The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: At an intersection with no stop line or crosswalk markings, where should you stop?

options.text: You do not need to stop.
Slow down to check if traffic is clear.
Stop far enough into the intersection to see 200 feet on both sides.
Stop where you can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where you can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Stop at the closest safe point where you can see oncoming traffic. Do not drive into the intersection to get a better view.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes going your direction, which lane should you use?

options.text: The lane closest to your previous lane.
The lane with an arrow marking.
The middle lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane nearest to where you came from. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
School crossing ahead.
Do not drive in this lane.
Vehicles turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Vehicles turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic lights. It means drivers turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ colored and must always be obeyed.

options.text: White
Blue
Green
Orange

questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic movement. They are usually white with black text and must be followed by all drivers.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you move onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Wait until you are on the exit ramp before slowing down. Do not slow down before entering it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Farm machinery.
Steep downgrade.
Do not enter.
Left turn yield on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farm machinery.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that farm machinery may be in the area.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you should:

options.text: Drive slowly to give approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to move.
Honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to move.
Stop and only enter when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
Ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and only enter when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the road from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians. Stop before crossing the sidewalk area. Failure to stop is against the law.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: Another driver is trying to pass your car. You should:

options.text: Pull off the road.
Signal to the other driver when it is safe to pass.
Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to allow safe passing.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to allow safe passing.
questions.explanation: Keep right when another driver begins to pass you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and slow down to help the passing vehicle return to the right lane safely.

questions.question: You are in an accident and another person is injured. You should:

options.text: Move the injured away from the scene right away.
Always leave the injured where they are.
Do not move the injured unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from the injured.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move the injured unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move injured people unless necessary. Improper handling can make minor injuries worse. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is severe bleeding, apply direct pressure to stop the flow.

questions.question: If another car might hit you, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn.
Wave your arms.
Use your emergency lights.
Flash your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound your horn.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. For example, sound your horn if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?

options.text: New drivers
Human error
Bad weather
Bad roads

questions.correctAnswerText: Human error
questions.explanation: Crashes often happen when a driver does not see another vehicle or does something unexpected. Communicate with other drivers to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep right.
Low shoulder.
No parking at any time.
Lane ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells drivers to keep right to avoid an upcoming hazard.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Continue normally through the intersection.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means "caution." Slow down, look, and proceed with care.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, turn your steering wheel:

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. As the vehicle straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, you should:

options.text: Stop right away and let the vehicle pass.
Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Keep moving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle uses its lights or siren, you must let it pass. Move to the right side of the road as far as you safely can and stop. Do not stop in an intersection.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb:

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill near a curb, turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll into the curb instead of into traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop.
Side road.
Two-way left turn.
Farm machinery.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop. You must stop at an intersection and yield the right-of-way. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Start up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: These signs indicate:

options.text: Hazardous objects.
Slippery roads.
Traffic signals.
Intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hazardous objects.
questions.explanation: These are object markers. They warn drivers about objects or areas that may be dangerous and should be avoided. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about road and traffic conditions ahead.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road and traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They warn you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Steep grade ahead.
Pedestrian crossing ahead.
Low ground railroad crossing.
Low clearance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is low clearance ahead. Do not drive under the overpass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: You are driving in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. You should:

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: When changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Go straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling that they plan to turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: When approaching a traffic signal with a steady yellow arrow, drivers:

options.text: Should move into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Should slow down and stop, if it is safe to do so.
May turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
Have the right-of-way and can expect oncoming traffic to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should slow down and stop, if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is about to appear. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow at a traffic signal, you can:

options.text: Merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn in the direction of the arrow. First, yield to any traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection.
Drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow. First, yield to any traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane for the turn. Always yield to vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No U-turn.
Two-way left turn.
Minimum speed limit.
No parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they must obey traffic rules. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area you:

options.text: Cannot see without turning your head.
See directly behind your vehicle.
See in your rearview mirror.
See in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are located on the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign warns that:

options.text: A steep hill is ahead.
Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
A logging road is ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Roundabout ahead.
No passing zone.
Left turn yield on green.
Traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When driving near large trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The longer stopping distance that large vehicles need.
The shorter stopping distance that large vehicles need.
The reduced noise from large vehicles.
The higher speed of large vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer stopping distance that large vehicles need.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay in a position where the truck driver can see you, and keep your view of traffic clear.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, you should first:

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up next to the car in front of the empty space.
Back up slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up next to the car in front of the empty space.
questions.explanation: After checking for traffic and signaling, pull up alongside the car in front of the space you want. Then turn your wheels and back in carefully.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other:

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing.
After one train passes, check the other track for another train before crossing.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for another train before crossing.
questions.explanation: When there are two tracks side by side, watch for a second train after the first one passes. Make sure no train is coming on either track before you cross.

questions.question: For the first 180 days with a probationary license, a driver:

options.text: Can drive after midnight.
Cannot transport immediate family members.
Should only drive under posted speed limits.
Can only drive between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can only drive between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.
questions.explanation: New probationary drivers have driving restrictions for the first 180 days. You cannot drive between 10:00 pm and 5:00 am. Without a qualified adult, you cannot transport passengers who are not your child, sibling, or spouse.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed from the side with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the side with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the side with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means only the driver on the broken line side can pass.
